name: of1-comparison-versus
description: Two-column head-to-head split of exactly two plans separated by a center VS badge, each side with image, price, feature list and CTA, plus shared-benefits and a which-is-right decision section.

slots.instruction: Short kicker above the hero title, e.g. the product line.
Hero headline naming the two options being compared, e.g. 'Plan A vs Plan B'.
One or two sentences framing the head-to-head decision.
Primary hero call to action.
Image representing the first (left) option.
Name of the first option.
Price line for the first option, e.g. '$30/mo per line'.
One-line pitch for the first option.
3-5 key features of the first option, each a short phrase.
Call to action for the first option.
Short center divider label, typically 'VS'.
Image representing the second (right) option.
Name of the second option.
Price line for the second option.
One-line pitch for the second option.
3-5 key features of the second option, each a short phrase.
Call to action for the second option.
Heading for benefits both options share.
3-5 benefits common to both options, each a short phrase.
Heading for the which-is-right-for-you section.
Label for the first guidance card, e.g. 'Go with Plan A if...'.
Sentence describing who should pick the first option.
Label for the second guidance card, e.g. 'Go with Plan B if...'.
Sentence describing who should pick the second option.
Closing call-to-action heading.
One sentence encouraging the next step.
Closing primary button link.

label: Comparison — Head-to-Head Versus
